race.comment: ALTHOFF (9) comes here with a fitness edge over most of these fourth-up. Drifted back early and looped the field with a dominant victory over 1500m at Rosehill in BM100 grade. Has further upside and can pick these up on the limit weight. GENERAL SALUTE (3) Group-winning sprinter who profiles well with residual fitness from the low draw. Has looked to be airborne in his two slick trial wins and shapes as the value player. HEADLEY GRANGE (1) tough warhorse who saves his best for this track and trip. Kept finding with the 58kg to salute in a tight finish first up in the G2 Tramway Stakes over 1400m here. Goes just as well second up and can manage the weight increase from the right gate. Respect. MATCHA LATTE (10) stalked the fast tempo first up with a narrow third in the G3 Show County over 1200m at this track. Since kept up to the mark with a 1030m trial at Rosehill. Best form is over this trip.
